ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; approximately 15% high-intensity white pixels localized at the distal tips versus 85% low-intensity dark pixels across the main body.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches at the lateral distal tips of both lobes. Left lobe distal tip contains a larger irregular white zone with internal low-intensity speckling; right lobe distal tip contains a smaller, more discrete white patch. The central fluke surface is a continuous low-intensity dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/6th of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Left lobe displays more frequent small-amplitude peaks; right lobe shows larger, distinct valleys towards the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edges show a primary convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast brownish-orange pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Sparse white circular points are visible on the dark surface of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (white rake marks) located on the medial-lateral section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Diagonal linear rake marks on the left lobe surface; brownish organic growth/barnacle clusters at the fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive water droplet spray patterns causing localized pixel obscuration across the peduncle and lower central fluke region.
